4feb73d82669e541: Now communicate with your partner so that he/she can grip the other side of the towel to apply resistance. Tip: The upper arms should remain stationary and only the forearms should move. Breathe in as you perform this step.
8b48c205b6cae7df: Go back to the starting position by using the triceps to raise the towel. Breathe out as you perform this step.
